name: i9_10a_event_centre
steps: lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) if not p:isFuncOpen(xyd.FunctionID.ID_ACT_CENTRE) then error('vc-event-centre-closed') end _G.ec=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.EVENTCENTRE) _G.ecErrors={} _G.ecDone={} _G.ecBuild=function(t) _G.ec:upgradeBuilding({type=t},function(c1) if c1~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'start-'..t..'-'..tostring(c1)) return end _G.ec:speedUpBuilding({type=t},function(c2) if c2~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'speed-'..t..'-'..tostring(c2)) return end _G.ec:confirmBuildingUpgrade({type=t},function(c3) if c3~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'confirm-'..t..'-'..tostring(c3)) return end _G.ecDone[t]=(_G.ecDone[t] or 0)+1 end) end) end) end _G.ec:getBuildingList({},function(c) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'list-'..tostring(c)) end end)
lua:if #_G.ecErrors~=0 then error('vc-ec-setup-'..table.concat(_G.ecErrors,',')) end if type(_G.ec.buidingInfo)~='table' then error('vc-ec-buildings-missing') end
lua:_G.ecMake=nil _G.ec:makeItem({item_id=20001091},function(c,b) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'make-'..tostring(c)) return end _G.ecMake=b end)
lua:if not _G.ecMake then error('vc-ec-make-'..table.concat(_G.ecErrors,',')) end if tonumber(_G.ecMake.is_making)~=1 or tonumber(_G.ecMake.making_item)~=20001091 then error('vc-ec-make-reply') end
lua:_G.ecSpeed=nil _G.ec:accelerateMakeItem({speed_num=348,building_type=2},function(c,b) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'speed-'..tostring(c)) return end _G.ecSpeed=b end)
lua:if not _G.ecSpeed then error('vc-ec-accelerate-'..table.concat(_G.ecErrors,',')) end if tonumber(_G.ecSpeed.is_making)~=0 then error('vc-ec-accelerate-reply') end
lua:_G.ecConfirm=nil _G.ec:confirmMakeItem({building_type=2},function(c,b) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'confirm-'..tostring(c)) return end _G.ecConfirm=b end)
lua:if not _G.ecConfirm or type(_G.ecConfirm.items)~='table' or tonumber(_G.ecConfirm.items[1].table_id)~=20001091 then error('vc-ec-confirm-'..table.concat(_G.ecErrors,',')) end

lua:_G.ecAdmin=nil _G.ec:getAdminInfo({},function(c,b) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'admin-info-'..tostring(c)) return end _G.ec:adminConversion({from_type=2,to_type=11},function(c2) if c2~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'admin-'..tostring(c2)) return end _G.ecAdmin=true end) end)
lua:_G.ecBoard=nil _G.ec:getNoticeBoardInfo({},function(c,b) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'board-'..tostring(c)) return end _G.ecBoard=b end)

lua:if not _G.ecBoard or type(_G.ecBoard.mission_list)~='table' or #_G.ecBoard.mission_list==0 then error('vc-ec-board-'..table.concat(_G.ecErrors,',')) end local pick=nil for i=1,#_G.ecBoard.mission_list do if tonumber(_G.ecBoard.mission_list[i].type)==1 then pick=_G.ecBoard.mission_list[i] break end end if not pick then error('vc-ec-board-no-normal-offer') end _G.ecMission=pick.mission_id

lua:_G.ecReceive=nil _G.ec:receiveMission({mission_id=_G.ecMission,leader=1,partners={},wish_crystal=0},function(c,b) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'receive-'..tostring(c)) return end _G.ecReceive=b end)

lua:if not _G.ecReceive then error('vc-ec-receive-'..table.concat(_G.ecErrors,',')) end _G.ec:getNoticeBoardInfo({},function(c,b) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'board-reload-'..tostring(c)) return end local found=false for i=1,#b.doing_mission_list do if tonumber(b.doing_mission_list[i].mission_id)==tonumber(_G.ecMission) then found=true end end if not found then error('vc-ec-board-doing-missing') end end)

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) if not p:isFuncOpen(xyd.FunctionID.ID_ACT_CENTRE) then error('vc-event-centre-closed-reload') end _G.ec=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.EVENTCENTRE) _G.ecErrors={} _G.ec:getBuildingList({},function(c) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'list-reload-'..tostring(c)) end end)
lua:_G.ecRecycle=nil _G.ec:recycleItems({item_id=30001006,item_num=1},function(c,b) if c~=xyd.error.OK then table.insert(_G.ecErrors,'recycle-'..tostring(c)) return end _G.ecRecycle=b end)

lua:if not _G.ecRecycle then error('vc-ec-recycle-'..table.concat(_G.ecErrors,',')) end if type(_G.ecRecycle.resolve_types)~='table' or tonumber(_G.ecRecycle.energy)<=0 then error('vc-ec-recycle-reply') end
note: Stock EventCentreMainWindow and EventCentre model: builds desk/recycle/administrator/board at level two through MID1057/1077/1080, then make 1075, accelerate 1089 and confirm 1088. A relogin (fresh Lua VM, same account) gives the server-side 15-second recycle energy tick real time, then 1073 recycle, 1082 administrator and 1083/1084 notice board run. Fixture grants only currency and the stock materials the flow consumes; building levels, make state, admin counts and board missions are earned through the production service.
